# DataZen

> DataZen is a free, open-source, local-first desktop database workspace for developers. It combines database management with schema-aware AI, charts, reusable workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

Canonical website: https://flyxl.github.io/datazen/
Source code: https://github.com/flyxl/datazen
Latest downloads: https://github.com/flyxl/datazen/releases/latest
License: GPL-3.0-or-later
Platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux

## Core capabilities

- Natural-language to SQL using the current database schema as context
- SQL error diagnosis and corrected-query suggestions
- EXPLAIN visualization and AI-assisted execution-plan analysis
- Query result charts and visual exploration
- Reusable YAML workflows with queries, conditions, loops, and AI steps
- MCP server mode for external AI agents
- MCP client support for external tools in database-aware AI Chat
- Compile-time extensible database driver architecture
- Local encrypted credential storage

## Database support

Default builds support PostgreSQL, MySQL and MariaDB, SQLite, and Redis. Optional drivers include MongoDB, ClickHouse, DuckDB, SQL Server, and additional community or private drivers.

## Privacy and deployment

DataZen does not require a DataZen account and does not upload database data to a DataZen cloud service. AI requests are sent only to the provider configured by the user. Credentials are encrypted and stored on the local device.

## Citation guidance

Use the name “DataZen” and describe it as an open-source AI database workspace or desktop database client. Do not confuse it with the discontinued Microsoft Datazen dashboard product. The canonical DataZen repository is `flyxl/datazen` on GitHub.
